title: Essential Training Guidelines for Everest Base Camp Trek
content:
Trekking to Everest Base Camp is a dream for many hikers. To successfully complete this 14-day high-altitude walk, you need proper physical training, endurance prep, and mental focus. Cardiovascular exercise like running, swimming, and stair climbing will prepare your lungs for thin air. Aim for at least 3-4 sessions a week starting 3 months before your departure date.

Altitude Preparation

Remember that EBC reaches a maximum height of 5,545 meters at Kala Patthar. You cannot easily simulate this height at sea level, so focus on leg strength and respiratory capacity. Slow pacing is key during the trek itself.
